stem.text: How many statements are true for semi-conservative replication of DNA in a prokaryotic cell?

items: the process takes place in the cytoplasm
an adenine nucleotide will line up against a uracil on the template strand
each new DNA molecule will contain one strand from the parent molecule
if the parent molecule contained 40% guanine nucleotides each new DNA molecule will contain 20% guanine nucleotides
